rationale.reason: CARRY_TERM_STRUCTURE is locally blocked. The other open families have structural results or prior diagnostics; rerunning or retuning those tests on the same observed data would not be a fresh prospective decision. Cross-market lead-lag is the remaining plausible frontier, but its prior one-bar and fixed-15-minute diagnostics preclude reparameterizing the same tests. New predeclared authority must define a genuinely distinct hypothesis and independent data scope before proceeding.
